description.value: The Fruitvale Pub & Grill is a neighbourhood pub on historic Main Street in the Beaver Valley, serving hand-ground burgers, dry ribs, crispy chicken, and fresh salads from an open-concept kitchen. It also operates a convenient to-go counter for cold beer, coolers, and wine — handy for cyclists stocking up mid-route. The relaxed atmosphere, local draft beer, and scratch-made sauces make it a genuine community gathering spot in the Kootenays.
